kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تصاعبت (form VI)
# تَصَاعَبْتُ (taṣāʕabtu) /ta.sˤaː.ʕab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
# تَصَاعَبْتَ (taṣāʕabta) /ta.sˤaː.ʕab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
# تَصَاعَبْتِ (taṣāʕabti) /ta.sˤaː.ʕab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
# تَصَاعَبَتْ (taṣāʕabat) /ta.sˤaː.ʕa.bat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
